text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A and D after gains felt good, but I should let expected returns and risk—not the urge to lock in a profit—determine when I sell.","I bought more Stock C at higher prices, then sold at a substantial loss; I should require a clear investment thesis before adding and reassess it promptly when the facts change.","My losses in E and C show how painful it can be to admit a mistake. I should set consistent portfolio-level risk limits and act on them rather than anchor on average cost or hope to break even."]}
